t_advice_summary_textbox.text: green , yellow, blue and green gnomes will take you to a forrest until your picking 0,1 or 2 mushrooms then take you to another. If one gnomes particularly gives low yeild, stick with them for 4 or 5 turns then change.

vb_textbox.text: green, orange, yellow and blue gnomes all take you to the same forest. Stick with this group of gnomes until mushrooms stop giving a good yield then switch.
